import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    maxL = -1
    nwi = 0
    fp = 0
    fw = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        c = s[i]
        if c == '(':
            fp += 1
            fw = 0
        elif c == ')':
            if fp == 1 and fw != 0:
                nwi += 1
            fp -= 1
            fw = 0
        elif c == '_':
            if fp == 1 and fw != 0:
                nwi += 1
            fw = 0
        else:
            fw += 1
        if fp == 0:
            maxL = max(fw, maxL)
        i += 1
    print(f"{maxL} {nwi}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
